prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, highly legible pixel-perfect design mockup for the existing Chadashot RSS reader. Landscape 1536x1024 design board, white/light sage background. NOT a photograph of a monitor. The board shows a large desktop feed list panel on the left and a narrower mobile feed list panel on the right, same design and articles. Screens are front-on flat UI. Focus on the feed ITEM LIST, no article reading pane required. 
Existing design invariants: clean Inter/system sans serif, white surfaces #ffffff, thin dividers #dce2dd, text #18201c, muted #69756e, green accent #39735d, selected first item pale sage #e7eee9 with 3px green left border. List header "Inbox" with green count pill "24"; segmented controls "All" "Unread" "Read" with Unread green; outline button "Mark all read" beneath on mobile as needed. Above list small "Chadashot" brand. Each row has small source, read-time and age metadata, bold 15px-equivalent headline, muted short summary, green unread dot and outline star in a dedicated slim far-right control column. No new settings or unrelated controls. Header and typography must be crisp and readable.
Same sample article order in both views:
1 source "Field Notes", metadata "4 min" and "2h", headline "Finding quiet in the forest", summary "A weekend walk through the woods, away from the noise." associated image: realistic sunlit green forest path. SELECTED row.
2 source "Design Journal", metadata "6 min" and "4h", headline "A home built around daylight", summary "Thoughtful spaces that make room for light." associated image: realistic warm minimalist building and daylight.
3 source "The Reading Room", metadata "3 min" and "6h", headline "On keeping a reading notebook", summary "A few words about remembering what we read." This article has NO image. Show natural full-width text WITHOUT a blank image rectangle or generic placeholder.
4 source "Science Weekly", metadata "5 min" and "8h", headline "A closer look at the night sky", summary "New perspectives on a familiar constellation." associated image: realistic stars and mountains at night.
Use tasteful actual photographic thumbnails. No text inside photos. Include small caption under each viewport "Desktop" and "Mobile". No watermarks. Accurate spacing and alignment matter more than decoration.
Title at top of design board, verbatim: "01 · Compact left thumbnail". Subtitle "Small image, familiar list density". Layout: 64x64px-equivalent square photo at LEFT of row, modest 6px corner radius, text block to its right. Row metadata within text block. 12px gap, 16px row padding, about 112px-equivalent row height. ALL rows remain compact and readable. On mobile image is 56x56px and title wraps naturally, summaries one or two lines. No-image third row text begins at normal 16px left padding and spans available row width. Show all four rows on both viewports, extra white space beneath. This option must use square left thumbnails, not banners or right images.
